notes: Both final images were generated with the Codex app built-in image_gen tool without a paid image API.
The first inline attempt was discarded because it contained too much text.
Hero and inline images have different roles and compositions.
Hosted copies use unique filenames under src/images/ai_assets/hosted/.
Publishing must stop if either required image is missing or reused.

prompt_policy.api_cost_policy: No OpenAI Images API or external paid image API was used.
prompt_policy.prompt_method: Fresh one-off prompts were written from the article intent, image role, and recent Korea image history.
prompt_policy.diversity_rule: Avoid traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes.
prompt_policy.quality_loop: The text-heavy first inline result was rejected and regenerated as a mostly wordless object flow.

images.alt: A foreign resident preparing identity and purpose documents at a Korean bank counter
images.caption: Prepare identity, address, and transaction-purpose evidence before visiting the branch.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt, not a reusable template. Image role: hero. Role purpose: show the branch preparation and identity-verification moment. Photorealistic editorial scene at a modern Korean bank counter: a foreign resident seen from a side/back angle organizes a passport, unreadable generic residence card, proof-of-address envelope, and employment or university document while a bank employee gestures toward a blank application. Wide landscape, calm morning light, unbranded branch, documentary realism. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table scenes. No readable personal data, logos, currency piles, text overlay, or watermark.

images.alt: A wordless preparation flow showing resident and short-stay document paths, branch setup, and transfer-limit checks
images.caption: A stronger resident-document path and a more uncertain passport-only path both lead to branch-specific approval and limit checks.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off prompt, not a reusable template. Image role: inline process and comparison checklist. Role purpose: compare the stronger resident-document path with the uncertain passport-only path, then show branch setup and limit checks. Completely wordless top-down educational still life on pale wood. Two preparation trays: teal with closed passport, generic residence-ID silhouette, house document, SIM, and work/student pictogram; muted red with passport, smaller document bundle, and caution triangle. Arrows lead to queue ticket, signature pen, unbranded debit card, security token, then a transfer-limit gauge, shield, and check mark. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, cafe-table scenes, and do not make this a second version of the hero. No words, letters, pseudo-writing, personal data, bank logos, currency, smartphone, fake UI, or watermark.
